title: MatRecordJSON v0.1 — Working Draft
description: Normalized representation of MTRs, CMTRs, mill certificates, certificates of compliance, inspection certificates, laboratory reports, heat-treatment records, NDE reports, traceability records, reviewer annotations, and related evidence. MatRecordJSON records what the evidence package reports. It does not determine compliance. MatCheckJSON compares normalized MatRecordJSON evidence against applicable MatSpecJSON and MatReqJSON requirements.
